Median household income by tract

Click any area to load it below. Scroll to zoom, drag to pan. The heavy outline is the selected city; hairlines are county borders.
Source: US Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates, table-based Summary File (), for nine Bay Area counties: Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Solano and Sonoma. Tract-to-city assignment derived from the 2020 Census block assignment file. ZIP codes are ZIP Code Tabulation Areas (ZCTAs), the Census Bureau's areal approximation of USPS delivery routes: they carry the same five digits but are not identical to postal ZIPs, PO-box-only ZIPs have no ZCTA, and a ZCTA can cross county lines (33 of the 310 here do), so each is parented to the county holding most of its land area. Dollar figures are inflation-adjusted to 2024. Values marked ≥ are topcoded by the Census Bureau; ± figures are 90% margins of error.
